<div style="font-family:Times New Roman;">

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p align="center" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:center;text-autospace:none;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">INVITATION
TO ANNUAL GENERAL MEETING OF TRANSOCEAN LTD.</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p align="center" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:center;text-autospace:none;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">Friday,
May&nbsp;14, 2010</font></b></p>

<p align="center" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:center;text-autospace:none;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">4&nbsp;p.m.,
Swiss time,</font></b></p>

<p align="center" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:center;text-autospace:none;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">at the
Parkhotel Zug, Industriestrasse 14, CH-6304 Zug, Switzerland</font></b></p>

<p align="center" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:center;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">Agenda Items</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><b><i><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:bold;">(1)</font></i></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">Approval of the 2009 Annual Report,
including the Consolidated Financial Statements of Transocean Ltd. for Fiscal
Year 2009 and the Statutory Financial Statements of Transocean Ltd. for Fiscal
Year 2009.</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">Proposal of the Board of Directors</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">The Board of Directors proposes that the 2009 Annual
Report, including the consolidated financial statements for fiscal year 2009
and the statutory financial statements for fiscal year 2009 be approved.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><b><i><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:bold;">(2)</font></i></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">Discharge of the Members of the Board
of Directors and the Executive Officers for Fiscal Year 2009.</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">Proposal of the Board of Directors</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">The Board of Directors proposes that discharge be
granted to the members of the Board of Directors and the executive officers
from liability for activities during fiscal year 2009.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><b><i><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:bold;">(3)</font></i></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">Appropriation of the Available
Earnings for Fiscal Year 2009 to be Carried Forward.</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">&nbsp;</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">Proposal of the Board of Directors</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">The Board of Directors proposes that all available
earnings of the Company be carried<b>  </b>forward.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><b><i><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:bold;">(4)</font></i></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">Change of the Company&#146;s Place of
Incorporation in Switzerland. </font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">Proposal of the Board of Directors</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">The Board of Directors proposes that the Company
change its place of incorporation in Switzerland from Zug, Canton of Zug,
Switzerland, to Steinhausen, Canton of Zug, Switzerland.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">The proposed amendment to the Articles of Association
is included in Annex A.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><b><i><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:bold;">(5)</font></i></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">Renewal of the Company&#146;s Authorized
Share Capital.</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">Proposal of the Board of Directors</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">The Board of Directors proposes that the Articles of
Association be amended to renew the Company&#146;s authorized share capital until
May&nbsp;14, 2012.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">The proposed amendments to the Articles of Association
are included in Annex B.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><b><i><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:bold;">(6)</font></i></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">Distribution to Shareholders in the
Form&nbsp;of a Par Value Reduction.</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">Proposal of the Board of Directors</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">The Board of Directors proposes approval of a
resolution of shareholders and the related amendments to the Articles of
Association with respect to the payment of a distribution to shareholders in
the form of a par value reduction in an amount in Swiss francs (&#171;CHF&#187;) equal to
3.11 U.S. dollars (&#171;USD&#187;) per issued share (including treasury shares) to be
calculated and paid in USD in four quarterly installments, all as further set
forth in Annex C.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><b><i><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:bold;">(7)</font></i></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">Amendments to the Articles of
Association to Reflect The Swiss Federal Act on Intermediated Securities.</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">Proposal of the Board of Directors</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">The Board of Directors proposes that the Articles of
Association be amended to reflect the The Swiss Federal Act on Intermediated
Securities, which became effective as of January&nbsp;1, 2010.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">The proposed amendments to the Articles of Association
are included in Annex D.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><b><i><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:bold;">(8)</font></i></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><b><i><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:bold;">(9)</font></i></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">Appointment of Ernst&nbsp;&amp; Young
LLP as the Company&#146;s Independent Registered Public Accounting Firm for Fiscal
Year 2010 and Reelection of Ernst&nbsp;&amp; Young Ltd., Zurich, as the
Company&#146;s Auditor for a Further One-Year Term.</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">Proposal of the Board of Directors</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">The Board of Directors proposes that Ernst&nbsp;&amp;
Young LLP be appointed as Transocean Ltd.&#146;s independent registered public
accounting firm for the fiscal year 2010 and that Ernst&nbsp;&amp; Young Ltd.,
Zurich, be reelected as Transocean Ltd.&#146;s auditor pursuant to the Swiss Code of
Obligations (&#171;Swiss Code&#187;) for a further one-year term, commencing on the day
of election at the 2010 annual general meeting and terminating on the day of
the 2011 annual general meeting.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">Organizational Matters</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">A copy of the proxy materials, including a proxy and
admission card, has been sent to each shareholder registered in Transocean
Ltd.&#146;s share register as of March&nbsp;15, 2010. Any additional shareholders
who are registered in Transocean Ltd.&#146;s share register on April&nbsp;26, 2010
will receive a copy of the proxy materials after April&nbsp;26, 2010.
Shareholders not registered in Transocean Ltd.&#146;s share register as of
April&nbsp;26, 2010 will not be entitled to attend, vote or grant proxies to
vote at, the 2010 annual general meeting. No shareholder will be entered in
Transocean Ltd.&#146;s share register as a shareholder with voting rights between
the close of business on April&nbsp;26, 2010 and the opening of business on the
day following the annual general meeting. BNY Mellon Shareowner Services, which
maintains Transocean Ltd.&#146;s share register, will, however, continue to register
transfers of Transocean Ltd. shares in the share register in its capacity as
transfer agent during this period.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Shareholders registered in Transocean Ltd.&#146;s share
register as of April&nbsp;26, 2010 have the right to attend the annual general
meeting and vote their shares, or may grant a proxy to vote on each of the
proposals in this invitation and any other matter properly presented at the
meeting for consideration to either Transocean Ltd. (as corporate proxy) or the
independent representative, Rainer Hager, by marking the proxy card
appropriately, executing it in the space provided, dating it and returning it
either to:</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt 18.45pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Transocean Ltd.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt 18.45pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Vote Processing</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt 18.45pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">c/o Broadridge</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt 18.45pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">51 Mercedes Way</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt 18.45pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Edgewood, NY 11717</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .25in;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .25in;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">or, if granting a proxy to the independent
representative:</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .25in;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .25in;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Rainer Hager</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .25in;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Attorney-at-Law and Notary</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .25in;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Schweiger Advokatur/Notariat</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .25in;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Dammstrasse 19</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .25in;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">CH-6300 Zug</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .25in;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Switzerland</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">We urge you to return your proxy card by 4&nbsp;p.m.
Eastern Daylight Time (EDT) | 10&nbsp;p.m. Swiss time on May&nbsp;13, 2010 to
ensure that your proxy card is timely submitted.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Shares of holders who have timely submitted a properly
executed proxy card and specifically indicated their votes will be voted as
indicated. Shares of holders who have timely submitted a properly executed
proxy card and have not specifically indicated their votes (irrespective of
whether a proxy has been granted to Transocean Ltd. or the independent
representative or neither is specified) will be voted in the manner recommended
by the Board of Directors and Transocean Ltd. or, if proxy has been granted to
the independent representative, the independent representative will act as your
proxy. Any proxy card marked to grant a proxy to both Transocean Ltd. (as
corporate proxy) and the independent representative will be counted as a proxy
granted to Transocean Ltd. only.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">In the case of shareholders who have timely submitted
a properly executed proxy card, if any other matters are properly presented at
the meeting for consideration, Transocean Ltd. and the independent
representative, as applicable, will, in the absence of specific instructions to
the contrary, have the discretion to vote on these matters in the manner
recommended by the Board of Directors.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Shareholders who hold their shares in the name of a
bank, broker or other nominee should follow the instructions provided by their
bank, broker or nominee when voting their shares. Shareholders who hold their
shares in the name of a bank, broker or other nominee and wish to vote in
person at the meeting must obtain a valid proxy from the organization that
holds their shares.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">We may accept a proxy by any form of communication
permitted by Swiss law and our Articles of Association.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Please note that shareholders attending the annual
general meeting in person or by proxy are required to show their admission card
on the day of the annual general meeting. In order to determine attendance
correctly, any shareholder leaving the annual general meeting early or
temporarily is requested to present such shareholder&#146;s admission card upon
exit.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">Proxy Holders of Deposited Shares</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Institutions subject to the Swiss Federal Law on Banks
and Savings Banks and professional asset managers who hold proxies for
beneficial owners who did not grant proxies to Transocean Ltd. or the
independent representative are kindly asked to inform Transocean Ltd. of the
number and par value of the registered shares they represent as soon as
possible, but no later than May&nbsp;14, 2010, 12&nbsp;p.m. Swiss time, at the
admission office for the annual general meeting.</font></p>

<br clear="all" style="page-break-before:always;">
<div style="font-family:Times New Roman;">

<p align="center" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:center;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p align="center" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:center;text-autospace:none;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">Annex C</font></b></p>

<p align="center" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:center;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p align="center" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:center;text-autospace:none;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">Distribution
to Shareholders in the Form&nbsp;of a Par Value Reduction</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">The Board of Directors submits the shareholder
resolution set forth below for approval by the Company&#146;s shareholders. The
definitive numbers in the following resolution will be completed based upon the
USD amount recommended by the Board of Directors (i.e., USD 3.11 per share),
the Company&#146;s actual registered share capital as of the date of the 2010 annual
general meeting, and the exchange rate (rounded down to the nearest 0.01) as
determined by the Board of Directors in its discretion, based on an exchange
rate prevailing approximately two business days prior to the date of the 2010
annual general meeting (hereinafter the &#171;Exchange Rate&#187;). The Board of
Directors will communicate the definitive numbers prior to the date of the
annual general meeting. The bracketed numbers in the proposed shareholder
resolution set forth below are included for illustrative purposes only and are
based on the assumption that (A)&nbsp;the Company&#146;s registered share capital as
of the date of the 2010 annual general meeting amounts to CHF 5,028,529,470
divided into 335,235,298 registered shares with a par value of CHF 15 each and (B)&nbsp;the
Exchange Rate is CHF 1.07 per one USD.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">If the capital reduction is approved by shareholders
at the 2010 annual general meeting in accordance with the resolution below,
then, in addition to the impact on the par value of previously issued shares,
the par value of any share issued out of the Company&#146;s conditional share
capital or authorized share capital on or after the date of the 2010 annual
general meeting and prior to the last capital reduction date, shall be (x)&nbsp;on
the date such share is issued, CHF 15, less an amount equal to the amount of
one partial capital reduction, multiplied by the number of capital reduction
dates on or prior to such date, and (y)&nbsp;reduced by an amount equal to the
amount of one partial capital reduction on each capital reduction date
thereafter.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">Shareholder Resolution</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">IT IS RESOLVED, that based on an auditor report dated,
on or about, the date of this annual general meeting, which (A)&nbsp;was
prepared by Ernst&nbsp;&amp; Young Ltd., Zurich, Switzerland, the state
supervised auditing enterprise present at the 2010 annual general meeting, in
accordance with article 732 para. 2 of the Swiss Code, (B)&nbsp;confirms that
the receivables of the creditors of the Company are fully covered by assets
after giving effect to the full capital reduction resolved herein, and (C)&nbsp;is
available at the 2010 annual general meeting:</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><i><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-style:italic;">1.</font></i></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">the registered share capital of the Company in the
aggregate amount of CHF [5,028,529,470] shall be reduced by the amount of CHF
[1,126,390,601.28];</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><i><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-style:italic;">2.</font></i></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">it is acknowledged and recorded that the report of the
auditor dated as of the date of this annual general meeting confirms that the
receivables of the creditors of the Company are fully covered by assets after
giving effect to the share capital reduction described in clause (1)&nbsp;above;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><i><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-style:italic;">3.</font></i></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="1" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:9.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">subject to clause (5)&nbsp;and
(6)&nbsp;below, the capital reduction described in clause (1)&nbsp;above shall
be accomplished as follows:</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="1" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:9.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="2" face="Symbol" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&#183;</font><font size="1" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font><font size="2" style="font-size:10.0pt;">by reducing the par value per registered
share from CHF 15.00 to CHF [11.64] in four steps, <i>i.e.</i>, from CHF 15.00 to CHF [14.16] to be submitted to the
commercial register in July&nbsp;2010 or as soon after such period as is
practicable; from CHF [14.16] to CHF [13.32] to be submitted to the commercial
register in October&nbsp;2010 or as soon after such period as is practicable;
from CHF [13.32] to CHF [12.48] to be submitted to the commercial register in January&nbsp;2011
or as soon after such period as is practicable; and from CHF [12.48] to CHF
[11.64] to be submitted to the commercial register in April&nbsp;2011 or as
soon after such period as is practicable (each such reduction, a &#171;Partial Per
Share Reduction&#187;);</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="1" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:9.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="2" face="Symbol" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&#183;</font><font size="1" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font><font size="2" style="font-size:10.0pt;">by payment of each Partial Per Share
Reduction as soon as reasonably possible after the date of such Partial Per
Share Reduction&#146;s registration with the commercial register, in each case to be
paid in USD converted at an exchange rate, as determined by the Board of
Directors in its discretion, based on an exchange rate prevailing approximately
two business days prior to date of the relevant installment payment, unless a
shareholder elects to receive the Partial Per Share Reduction in CHF; and</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="1" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:9.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="2" face="Symbol" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&#183;</font><font size="1" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font><font size="2" style="font-size:10.0pt;">an updated report in accordance with
article 732 para. 2 Swiss Code by a state supervised auditing enterprise shall
be prepared in connection with, and be a condition to, each Partial Per Share
Reduction; and</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="1" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:9.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><i><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-style:italic;">4.</font></i></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="1" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:9.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">the aggregate amount of the capital reduction set
forth in clause 1 (and corresponding amount of Partial Per Share Reductions)
shall be increased by the amount of the par value reductions with respect to
shares issued out of the Company&#146;s authorized share capital or conditional
share capital on or after the date of the 2010 annual general meeting and prior
to the date on which the last Partial Per Share Reduction is registered in the
commercial register.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="1" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:9.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><i><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-style:italic;">5.</font></i></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="1" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:9.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">The Articles of Association of the Company shall be
amended as follows:</font></p>

<p align="center" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:center;text-autospace:none;"><font size="1" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:9.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><i><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-style:italic;">5.1</font></i></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="1" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:9.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">First partial capital reduction to be submitted for
registration with the commercial register in July&nbsp;2010 or as soon after
such period as is practicable; <i>provided
that:</i></font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="1" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:9.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.5in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font><font size="2" face="Symbol" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&#183;</font><font size="1" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font><font size="2" style="font-size:10.0pt;">the resolution to reduce the share capital was
published three times in the Swiss Official Gazette of Commerce before the
first partial capital reduction and in the manner provided for by the Articles
of Association;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="1" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:9.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="2" face="Symbol" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&#183;</font><font size="1" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font><font size="2" style="font-size:10.0pt;">the creditors of the Company were thereby
notified that they could request satisfaction or security by filing their
claims within two months after the date of the last of the three publications
in the Swiss Official Gazette of Commerce described above;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="1" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:9.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="2" face="Symbol" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&#183;</font><font size="1" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font><font size="2" style="font-size:10.0pt;">the two-month time period described above
has expired and all creditors who have filed claims within such period have, to
the extent so required, been satisfied or secured; and</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="1" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:9.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="2" face="Symbol" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&#183;</font><font size="1" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font><font size="2" style="font-size:10.0pt;">a public deed of compliance has been
established.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="1" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:9.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Article&nbsp;4, Article&nbsp;5 paragraph 1 and Article&nbsp;6
paragraph 1 (not including (a)&nbsp;and (b)) of the Articles of Association
shall be amended to read as of the date of registration in the commercial
register of the first partial capital reduction as follows:</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="1" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:9.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><i><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-style:italic;">5.2</font></i></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="1" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Second partial capital reduction to be submitted for
registration with the commercial register in October 2010 or as soon after such
period as is practicable; <i>provided that:</i></font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="1" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="2" face="Symbol" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&#183;</font><font size="1" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font><font size="2" style="font-size:10.0pt;">the first partial capital reduction has
been effected in accordance with this resolution and entered into the
commercial register;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="1" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="2" face="Symbol" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&#183;</font><font size="1" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font><font size="2" style="font-size:10.0pt;">the resolution to reduce the share
capital was published three times in the Swiss Official Gazette of Commerce
before the second partial capital reduction and in the manner provided for by
the Articles of Association;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="1" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="2" face="Symbol" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&#183;</font><font size="1" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font><font size="2" style="font-size:10.0pt;">the creditors were thereby notified that
they could request satisfaction or security by filing their claims within two
months after the date of the last of the three publications in the Swiss
Official Gazette of Commerce described above;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="1" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="2" face="Symbol" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&#183;</font><font size="1" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font><font size="2" style="font-size:10.0pt;">the two-month time period described above
has expired and all creditors who have filed claims within such period have, to
the extent so required, been satisfied or secured;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="1" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="2" face="Symbol" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&#183;</font><font size="1" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font><font size="2" style="font-size:10.0pt;">an auditor report prepared in accordance
with article 732 para. 2 of the Swiss Code, which report is up-to-date at the
time of the second partial capital reduction, is available and confirms that
the receivables of the creditors of the Company are fully covered by assets
after giving effect to the full capital reduction; and</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="1" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="2" face="Symbol" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&#183;</font><font size="1" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font><font size="2" style="font-size:10.0pt;">a public deed of compliance has been
established with respect to the second partial capital reduction.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="1" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:8.5pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Article 4, Article 5 paragraph 1 and Article 6
paragraph 1 (not including (a) and (b)) of the Articles of Association shall be
amended to read as of the date of registration in the commercial register of
the second partial capital reduction as follows:</font></p>

<div style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><hr size="1" width="25%" noshade color="black" align="left"></div>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><i><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-style:italic;">* Except
for par value, subject to adjustment as a result of any capital increase out of
authorized share capital or conditional share capital prior to the application
to the commercial register.</font></i></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><i><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-style:italic;">5.3</font></i></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Third partial capital
reduction to be submitted for registration with the commercial register in January
2011 or as soon after such period as is practicable; <i>provided that:</i></font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="2" face="Symbol" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&#183;</font><font size="1" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font><font size="2" style="font-size:10.0pt;">the first and
second partial capital reductions have been effected in accordance with this
resolution and entered into the commercial register;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="2" face="Symbol" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&#183;</font><font size="1" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font><font size="2" style="font-size:10.0pt;">the resolution
to reduce the share capital was published three times in the Swiss Official
Gazette of Commerce before the third partial capital reduction and in the
manner provided for by the Articles of Association;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="2" face="Symbol" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&#183;</font><font size="1" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font><font size="2" style="font-size:10.0pt;">the creditors
were thereby notified that they could request satisfaction or security by
filing their claims within two months after the date of the last of the three
publications in the Swiss Official Gazette of Commerce described above;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="2" face="Symbol" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&#183;</font><font size="1" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font><font size="2" style="font-size:10.0pt;">the two-month
time period described above in view of the third partial reduction has expired
and all creditors who have filed claims within such period have, to the extent
so required, been satisfied or secured;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="2" face="Symbol" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&#183;</font><font size="1" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font><font size="2" style="font-size:10.0pt;">an auditor
report prepared in accordance with article 732 para. 2 of the Swiss Code, which
report is up-to-date at the time of the third partial capital reduction, is
available and confirms that the receivables of the creditors of the Company are
fully covered by assets after giving effect to the full capital reduction; and</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="2" face="Symbol" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&#183;</font><font size="1" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font><font size="2" style="font-size:10.0pt;">a public deed of
compliance has been established with respect to the third partial capital
reduction.</font></p>

<div style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><hr size="1" width="25%" noshade color="black" align="left"></div>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><i><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-style:italic;">* Except
for par value, subject to adjustment as a result of any capital increase out of
authorized share capital or conditional share capital prior to the application
to the commercial register.</font></i></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><i><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-style:italic;">5.4</font></i></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Fourth partial capital
reduction to be submitted for registration with the commercial register in April
2011 or as soon after such period as is practicable; <i>provided that:</i></font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="2" face="Symbol" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&#183;</font><font size="1" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font><font size="2" style="font-size:10.0pt;">the first, second
and third partial capital reductions have been effected in accordance with this
resolution and entered into the commercial register;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="2" face="Symbol" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&#183;</font><font size="1" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font><font size="2" style="font-size:10.0pt;">the resolution
to reduce the share capital was published three times in the Swiss Official
Gazette of Commerce before the fourth partial capital reduction and in the
manner provided in the Articles of Association;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="2" face="Symbol" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&#183;</font><font size="1" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font><font size="2" style="font-size:10.0pt;">the creditors
were thereby notified that they could request either satisfaction or security
by filing their claims within two months after the date of the last of the
three publications in the Swiss Official Gazette of Commerce described above;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="2" face="Symbol" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&#183;</font><font size="1" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font><font size="2" style="font-size:10.0pt;">the two-month
time period described above in view of the fourth partial reduction has expired
and all creditors who have filed claims within such period have, to the extent
so required, been satisfied or secured;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="2" face="Symbol" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&#183;</font><font size="1" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font><font size="2" style="font-size:10.0pt;">an auditor
report prepared in accordance with article 732 para. 2 of the Swiss Code, which
report is up-to-date at the time of the fourth partial capital reduction, is
available and confirms that the receivables of the creditors of the Company are
fully covered by assets after giving effect to the full capital reduction; and</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt .5in;text-autospace:none;text-indent:-.25in;"><font size="2" face="Symbol" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&#183;</font><font size="1" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font><font size="2" style="font-size:10.0pt;">a public deed of
compliance has been established with respect to the fourth partial capital
reduction.</font></p>

registration in the commercial register of the fourth partial capital reduction

  </td>
  <td width="2%" valign="bottom" style="padding:0in 0in 0in 0in;width:2.0%;">
  <p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:1.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>
  </td>
  <td width="49%" valign="top" style="padding:0in 0in 0in 0in;width:49.0%;">
  <p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">The share capital may be
  increased in an amount not to exceed CHF [1,951,069,434.36]* through the issuance
  of up to [167,617,649]* fully paid-up Shares with a par value of CHF [11.64]
  per Share through:&#187; <i><font style="font-style:italic;">(</font>remainder of paragraph unchanged)</i></font></p>
  </td>
 </tr>
</table>

</div>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<div style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><hr size="1" width="25%" noshade color="black" align="left"></div>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><i><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-style:italic;">* Except
for par value, subject to adjustment as a result of any capital increase out of<b>  </b>authorized share capital or conditional
share capital prior to the application to the commercial register.</font></i></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><i><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-style:italic;">6.</font></i></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">It is the task of the Board
of Directors to execute this resolution of the 2010 annual general meeting, including,
but not limited to, setting the record date and the payment date in relation to
each partial capital reduction payment, and to file the required applications
with the Commercial Register of the Canton of Zug, Switzerland (article 716a
para. 1 point 6 in conjunction with art. 734 of the Swiss Code). In the event
that an auditor report prepared in accordance with article 732 para. 2 of the
Swiss Code for the second, third or fourth partial capital reductions does not
confirm that the receivables of the creditors of the Company are fully covered
by assets after giving effect to the full capital reduction or creditors of the
Company have requested satisfaction of or security for their claims, and such
claims have not been satisfied or secured, to the extent so required, any
subsequent partial capital reduction may not be effected.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<div align="center" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:center;"><hr size="1" width="25%" noshade color="black" align="center"></div>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">As further set forth in the
resolution of shareholders above, capital reduction payments will be made in
USD converted at a USD/CHF exchange rate as determined by the Board of
Directors in its discretion, based on an exchange rate prevailing approximately
two business days prior to the date of the relevant installment payment, unless
a shareholder timely elects to receive such payment in CHF. For each quarterly
installment payment, the period for such election will commence on the relevant
installment record date and expire on the date that is 10 calendar days prior
to the expected installment payment date at 4&nbsp;p.m., New York time. If you
are a holder of shares registered in our share register, you must elect in
writing to the following address:</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">BNY Mellon Shareowner
Services</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Attn: Steven Myers</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">480 Washington Boulevard</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">29th Floor</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Jersey City, NJ 07310 USA</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Fax number: +1 (732) 667-9464</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">If you hold your shares in
the name of a bank, broker or other nominee, please contact your bank, broker
or nominee in order to make election arrangements. The Board of Directors
expects to set the four payment dates for the four installments in July 2010,
October 2010, January 2011, and April 2011, respectively, or as soon after each
such period as is practicable. No distribution installment will be paid to
shareholders with respect to any shares that are issued between the record date
and payment date with respect to such installment. In any event, the Company
must register the partial capital reduction related to each installment in the
commercial register of the Canton of Zug prior to the payment of such
installment.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p align="center" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:center;text-autospace:none;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">Annex D</font></b></p>

<p align="center" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:center;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p align="center" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:center;text-autospace:none;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;">Amendments to the Articles of Association to Reflect
The Swiss Federal Act on Intermediated Securities</font></b></p>

<p align="center" style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-align:center;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

proposes that Article&nbsp;7 paragraph 1 and Article&nbsp;8 of the Articles of
Association be amended to read as follows <i><font style="font-style:italic;">(</font>changes marked)</i>:</font></p>

  Aktienbuchf&#252;hrung beauftragte Dritte ist berechtigt, bei Eintragung im
  Aktienbuch von der antragstellenden Person einen angemessenen Nachweis seiner
  Berechtigung an den Aktien zu verlangen.</u> &#196;ndert eine im Aktienbuch
  eingetragene Person ihre Adresse, so hat sie dies dem Aktienbuchf&#252;hrer
  mitzuteilen. Solange dies nicht geschehen ist, gelten alle brieflichen
  Mitteilungen der Gesellschaft an die im Aktienbuch eingetragenen Personen als
  rechtsg&#252;ltig an die bisher im Aktienbuch eingetragene Adresse erfolgt.</font></p>

  maintain, itself or through a third party, a share register that lists the
  surname, first name, address and citizenship (in the case of legal entities,
  the company name and company seat) of the holders and usufructuaries of the
  Shares as well as the nominees. <u>The Company or the third party maintaining
  the share register on behalf of the Company shall be entitled to request at
  the time of the entry into the share register from the Person requesting such
  entry appropriate evidence of that Person&#146;s title to the Shares.</u> A Person
  recorded in the share register shall notify the share registrar of any change
  in address. Until such notification shall have occurred, all written
  communication from the Company to persons of record shall be deemed to have
  validly been made if sent to the address recorded in the share register.</font></p>

  <p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><strike><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">(2)&nbsp;Die Gesellschaft
  kann jederzeit Zerti-fikate f&#252;r Aktien drucken und ausliefern und</font></strike><font size="2" style="font-size:10.0pt;">  <strike>mit
  Zustimmung des Aktion&#228;rs ausgege-bene Urkunden, die bei ihr eingeliefert
  wer-den, ersatzlos annullieren.</strike></font></p>
  </td>
  <td width="3%" valign="top" style="padding:0in 0in 0in 0in;width:3.08%;">

  any time print and</font></strike><font size="2" style="font-size:10.0pt;">  <strike>deliver certificates for the Shares, and may,</strike>
  <strike>with the consent of the shareholder, cancel</strike>  <strike>issued certificates
  that are delivered to it</strike>  <strike>without replacement.</strike></font></p>

  <p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">(3)&nbsp;<strike>Nicht-verurkundete
  Aktien und die damit</strike>  <strike>verbundenen Rechte k&#246;nnen nur durch</strike>  <strike>schriftliche
  Zession &#252;bertragen werden.</strike>  <strike>Eine solche Zession bedarf zur Wirksamkeit</strike>
  <strike>gegen&#252;ber der Gesellschaft der Anzeige</strike>  <strike>an die Gesellschaft. Werden
  nicht-verur-kundete Aktien.</strike>  <u>Werden Bucheffekten</u> im Auftrag <u>der
  Gesellschaft oder</u> des Aktion&#228;rs von <u>einer Verwahrungsstelle</u>, einem
  <u>Registrar,</u> Transfer Agenten, einer Trust Gesell-schaft, Bank oder
  einer &#228;hnlichen Gesell-schaft verwaltet (<strike>der <b>Transfer Agent</b></strike><b>  </b><u>die<b> Verwahrungsstelle</b>), so setzt Wirksamkeit
  gegen&#252;ber der Gesellschaft voraus, dass</u> diese<strike> Aktien</strike>  <u>Bucheffekten</u>
  und die damit verbundenen Rechte <strike>nur</strike>  <u>unter</u> Mitwirkung <strike>desTransfer
  Agenten</strike>  <u>der Verwahrungsstelle</u> &#252;bertragen <u>oder daran
  Sicherheiten bestellt</u> werden.</font></p>

  <td width="3%" valign="top" style="padding:0in 0in 0in 0in;width:3.08%;">

  <td width="48%" valign="top" style="padding:0in 0in 0in 0in;width:48.16%;">
  <p style="margin:0in 0in .0001pt;text-autospace:none;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">(3)&nbsp;<strike>Uncertificated
  Shares and the appurtenant rights associated therewith may be</strike>  <strike>transferred
  only by written assignment.</strike>  <strike>For the assignment to be valid against the</strike>
  <strike>Company, notification to the Company shall</strike>  <strike>be required. If
  uncertificated Shares </strike><u>If intermediated securities</u> are administered
  on behalf of <u>the Company or a</u> shareholder by <strike>a</strike>  <u>an
  intermediary, registrar</u>, transfer agent, trust company, bank or similar
  entity (the <b><strike><font style="font-weight:bold;">Transfer Agent</font></strike></b><strike>
  ), such Shares</strike>  <b><u style="font-weight:bold;">Intermediary</u></b><u>),
  any transfer or grant of a security interest in such intermediated securities</u>
  and the appurtenant rights associated therewith<u>, in order for such
  transfer or grant of a security interest to be valid against the Company</u>,
  <strike>may be transferred only with</strike> requires the cooperation of the<strike> Transfer
  Agent</strike>  <u>Intermediary</u>.</font></p>
